QuestInfo.name: A Present for Mother
QuestInfo.0: Ksha, a Flora soldier, has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Ksha wants to give a gift to his mother and asks you to get some potions to fill in the munitions instead of a teapot for his mother.
QuestInfo.2: At Ksha's request, you brought him the materials to decorate the teapot.
